result.label: case_09

agent.explanation: The supplier and bank account match the vendor master, and the unit price of 14.25 matches the agreed price list. However, the invoice bills 100 units of TWL-HT while the goods-received note GRN-5009 records only 90 units received. The quantity billed exceeds the quantity received, so the payment is held for review.
evidence: Invoice RT-8009 bills 100 units of TWL-HT at 14.25, total 1425.0
GRN-5009 records only 90 units of TWL-HT received
Vendor master lists V004 Ravi Textiles Pvt Ltd with agreed price 14.25 for TWL-HT
agent.supplier_question: Please confirm why the invoice bills 100 units when only 90 units were received per GRN-5009.

result.email_draft:
Subject: Invoice RT-8009 on Hold – Quantity Discrepancy

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

Our reference: Purchase Order PO-2026-1009

Your invoice RT-8009, dated October 6, 2026, totaling USD 1,425.00, is currently on hold due to the following discrepancy:

- Item TWL-HT: 100 units billed, while the goods-received note GRN-5009 confirms receipt of only 90 units.

Please confirm why the invoice reflects 100 units when only 90 units were received. Kindly issue a credit note for the excess 10 units or provide a corrected invoice reflecting the quantity received.

We look forward to your prompt response.

Kind regards,
